newsitem.title: USA: U.S. fighter jet crashes in Oklahoma.
newsitem.headline: U.S. fighter jet crashes in Oklahoma.

text.p: An F-16 fighter jet crashed near Tulsa, Oklahoma, Thursday but the pilot ejected safely and nobody on the ground was hurt, a military spokesman said.
Maj. Mark Berry, of Fort Smith, Ark., where the pilot was based, said the aircraft went down about 15 miles north of Tulsa during a training mission.
"The pilot ejected safely and is believed to be suffering only minor injuries. There were no injuries on the ground," he said.
Berry gave no other details, but said a military Board of Officials would investigate the crash in an effort to determine the cause.
